name: message-divider
title: Message Divider
description: An event in a conversation, between its messages (a day, the context compacted, the model switched, a branch): one centred line of small muted text between rules, an icon first, what can be followed a button a little brighter. With running, its words shimmer, respecting reduced motion; a compaction marker can show context compacted, compacting or failed with an icon and words.
